column1: # The dependency-union exceptions table only sees DECLARED-range conflicts
# between workspace packages. This table covers install-time conflicts the
# union cannot see: another dependency's peer/transitive requirement wins the
# flat top-level slot at the customer prefix, npm plans a nested copy for the
# payload — and cannot reify it inside the bundled tree (observed empirically:
# the planned dir is created EMPTY, which then terminates ESM walk-up and
# shadows the flat copy). Registered rows vendor the declarer's own resolved
# closure (pnpm-store realpath) under vendor/<npm-name>/; the compat-mirror
# step copies it into the package's own node_modules at install time, where
# nearest-wins resolution keeps the package on its true version.
# npm auto-installs peers and gives 0.40.1 the top-level slot, while
# claude-runner (and its dependents teamlead/edge-worker) need their resolved

column3: mem0ai peer ^0.40.1 wins the flat slot; claude-runner needs its own resolved ^0.77
